purpose: Preserve provenance and recovery routes for theorem branches removed from the current executable registry. Paths are historical and are not required to exist in the current tree.

entries.title: Finite closure classification
entries.summary: Classifies a supplied finite total deterministic update map as globally closing, recurrent, or multistable. Historical prerequisite, not part of the open-composition paper core.

entries.title: Non-nested edge preservation with supplied projections
entries.summary: A declared connected replacement graph can share one exact macro-law when edge relations preserve labels, outputs, legal actions, and successors.

entries.title: Transported target exact factorization
entries.summary: Under target-fiber consistency, output preservation, legal-row agreement, and successor closure, source labels induce an exact target projection.

entries.title: Conservative non-nested transport with target-only actions
entries.summary: A transported target projection extends to a conservative macro schema when target-only actions are uniformly available and macro-deterministic within target fibers.

entries.title: Non-nested newly-legal-word split
entries.summary: A newly legal target word that separates two carried states refutes that proposed carried merge.

entries.title: Delayed exposure and adaptive finite-evidence no-go
entries.summary: Finite transcript-only evidence cannot uniformly certify closure over a family admitting legal separating exposure beyond the experiment horizon without an independent horizon/grammar contract.

entries.title: Candidate-universal macro-law criterion
entries.summary: A deterministic candidate-universal macro law exists exactly when all retained candidate-induced action maps agree on the declared macro space.

entries.title: Joint exterior--mechanism lower bound
entries.summary: A supplied jointly realizable exterior-by-mechanism product with explicit distinguishing words forces the corresponding exact interface-memory lower bound.

entries.title: Frozen conditional experimental-design results
entries.summary: Conditional reset-panel, evidence-coverage, robustness, failure-domain, and observation-regime results after a structural quotient and operational contract have already been fixed.
